detailed_description:
The target video is in a cinematic ultra-realistic contemporary African mining drama, documentary-grade natural light mixed with hard sources, true skin texture with sweat and fine dust, real cloth physics on worn cotton, red laterite dust in the air, high dynamic range style. [Shot 1] the shot follows the viewpoint and subject placement of <Picture 1>; the subject is the same 24-year-old Chinese man throughout, same face, same short black hair, same faded pale-blue shirt with the sleeves rolled to the forearm over dark grey work trousers. The camera holds a static shot. His brows draw together by a hair and release; his throat moves once, then his eyes blink and drop a few degrees before coming back level to the left of frame. The speaker (S1) says in an off-screen voiceover, comes in Mandarin Chinese from off-screen, drawling and mocking, while the man visible in frame keeps his lips closed and still,: <d>[Chinese] 我们家可小，委屈你大学生了。</d> while their lips remain completely closed. an air-conditioning hum, the score adding one low string.
